TortOS on-screen strings, from ericreinsmidt/TortOS v1.0-3-g9b9c342.
%s, %d are the source's own format specifiers.

== Shelf (src/main.c) ==
%d game / %d games / %d album / %d albums
no games in Roms/%s
%d / %d
No games found
Put ROMs in Roms/<System>/ on the card
one folder per system, named as in systems.cfg
needs Bios/syscard3.pce

== Wi-Fi (src/wifi_menu.c) ==
Wi-Fi  on | off
<ssid>  strong | good | weak   + " - connected" | " - saved" | " - open"   ("saved" before a scan)
Turn Wi-Fi on to scan / No networks found / Scanning... / Y: rescan   X: forget / Y: rescan
Turning Wi-Fi on... / Wi-Fi did not come up / Connecting... / Connected to %s / Could not connect to %s
Forget %s? / Forget %s? You are connected to it and will lose the network.
Forget / Cancel / Forgot %s / Could not forget %s

== Bluetooth (src/bt_menu.c) ==
Bluetooth  no adapter | on | off;  <device>  connected | paired | in range
A: turn on at the next boot / A: turn on / Searching... / Y: search
A: turn off   Y: search / A: disconnect   Y: search   X: forget
A: connect   Y: search   X: forget / A: pair   Y: search

== Over The Hare ==
heading "<address>\nPIN <pin>";  Browsers (waiting | 1 connected | N connected);
Transferred ("X in / Y out" | nothing yet); Now;  Wi-Fi went away / Could not start / Scanning...

== Box Art ==
heading "Box Art\n<now | problem | Done | starting>";  Systems "a of b";
Art "x found, y missing, z already";  B to stop / B to close;  No network
one game: fetching | found | replaced | not found | not found, kept the old one

== Sign-in ==
RetroAchievements User / ScreenScraper User / Password
Not on a network. Connect Wi-Fi first. / This build has no ScreenScraper key.
Signing in... / Signed in as %s / Sign-in failed

== Keyboard (src/keyboard.c) ==
A type / B delete / X shift|unshift / Y symbols|letters / L/R cursor / START done / MENU cancel / space

== Game details (src/game_menu.c) ==
Synopsis (none) / Year / Genre / Cheevos ("E/N, P/T points" | none) / Get Box Art | Replace Box Art (needs Wi-Fi)

== Achievements ==
heading "<title>\nE/N cheevos   P/T points";  detail: <description> | The set carries no description.
Points / Status (Earned | Not earned);  toast "Unlocked  -  N point(s)"

== In-game ==
Continue / Save / Load / Display <mode> / Cheevos ("E / T" | none) / Reset / Quit
Save to / Load from / Auto / Slot N / Empty / "—" under an empty slot when saving

== Muse ==
tracks heading "<album>\n<artist>";  playing | paused;  "[Paused: ]<title>  -  <artist>   m:ss / m:ss"
N of M / Paused / Stopped / -m:ss / Next: %s
A: pause    L1/R1: track    Left/Right: seek    Y: mode   (A: play when paused)
